ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel coverage comprising approximately 65-70% of the visible surface, contrasted against high-intensity (white/off-white) regions in the mid-lower lobe sections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central axis and trailing edges are dominated by solid dark pigmentation; lower interior regions of both lobes exhibit white pigmentation with high-frequency, dark, irregular mottling and speckling (pixel clusters) distributed throughout.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 85-90 degrees, set at the convergence of the lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous non-linear boundary characterized by irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) with pixel-amplitudes of 5-12 pixels, most pronounced on the distal thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to slightly recurved, acute distal tips (fluke horns).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-25 pixel diameter) identified primarily within the dark-pigmented central and lateral zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-colored diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left interior lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular depigmented scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface; distinct irregular notched indentation on the distal-right trailing edge tip.
